extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from job metadata: AO3400, JSMSEMI, n-channel MOSFET.
The supplied four-page PDF is branded JSMICRO SEMICONDUCTOR/JSMSEMI and identifies AO3400 as an N-Channel Enhancement mode Field Effect Transistor in SOT-23.
No revision identifier or revision date is stated in the supplied PDF.

The RDS(on) table values are transcribed as inclusive maximums: 35 mOhm at VGS = 10 V and ID = 5.8 A, 40 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 5 A, and 52 mOhm at VGS = 2.5 V and ID = 4 A. The table note states pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2% for footnote 1 parameters.

Ciss is an inclusive maximum of 1050 pF; Coss and Crss are typical values of 99 pF and 77 pF. The shared table condition is VDS = 15 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz, and footnote 2 marks these parameters as not verified.
Output, transfer, RDS(on), and source-drain diode curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied typical plots on p. 3. No points were generated by interpolation.
The supplied PDF contains no capacitance-versus-VDS plot; capacitance curve extraction is therefore omitted.
The p. 1 absolute ratings include VDS = 30 V, VGS = +/-12 V, continuous ID = 5.8 A, PD = 0.35 W, TJ = 150 degC, and Tstg = -55 to 150 degC.
omission_reason: No capacitance-versus-VDS curve is present in the supplied PDF, so no capacitance curve was extracted.
